messages:
maria_fin: Partner (reseller R-3321) submitted a credit note for $12,400 dated 2026-03-18. I can't find a matching negative line on our reseller invoice run. Anyone seen this before?
ajay_sales: They emailed partners@ and attached a PDF + CSV. They referenced AWS settlement id MKT-98765 and invoice AWSINV-20260318-9856.
aws_billing_bot: Automated: Marketplace settlement MKT-98765 posted on 2026-03-18. Link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/settlements/MKT-98765
maria_fin: Quick lookup in our payer ledger shows an adjustment of -$12,150 for that same settlement id. There's a $250 gap. Could be tax or currency rounding.
lina_rev: We need to decide: 1) pass full credit to the reseller, 2) net to our payable, or 3) issue a contra invoice. Needs revenue signoff.
greg_ops: Can someone paste the partner CSV snippet? AWS sometimes splits tax lines into separate rows.
ajay_sales: Partner CSV (snippet pasted):
```
settlement_id,sku,amount,fee,tax
MKT-98765,RED-CORE-1,-12400,0,0
```
ajay_sales: Partner insists it's a single credit line for the reseller contract. reseller_id: R-3321.
maria_fin: Two action items: (A) Finance to reconcile the $250 difference with AWS detailed fees/tax, (B) if CSV confirms, prepare credit memo for $12,400 to apply to reseller account. Lina to approve revenue treatment.
lina_rev: Reviewed. We can book a contra revenue of $12,400 if it's customer-facing. Approval conditional on evidence that AWS reversed $12,400 to our payer account (settlement export or transaction screenshot).
maria_fin: Asked partner for full marketplace CSV and screenshot of settlement transaction. Also opened a support case with AWS for confirmation.
ajay_sales: Partner uploaded the full export to shared folder and pinged AWS support. Link: https://files.redwood.com/partners/R-3321/MKT-98765-full.csv
aws_billing_bot: file uploaded: https://files.redwood.com/partners/R-3321/MKT-98765-full.csv
maria_fin: Found the tax line in the full CSV: it shows $12,150 credit + $250 sales tax reversal = $12,400 total. That explains the delta.
greg_ops: GL mapping guidance: use revenue code 4002 (contra-marketplace) and tax code TXR-01. I'll draft the journal template for finance to use.
lina_rev: Approved. Maria, proceed to issue credit memo CM-20260319-778 for $12,400 and attach AWS CSV + screenshot + AWS case # for audit.
maria_fin: Creating CM-20260319-778 and applying to the next invoice cycle. Journal will be posted to GL on 2026-03-20. I'll copy you on the memo.
ajay_sales: Partner notified and happy. Will confirm once credit hits their account. :white_check_mark: 
maria_fin: Closing notes: credit applied 2026-03-20, journal posted 2026-03-20, AWS case CASE-4598 closed. Thanks all.
